notes.title: Giga Wrecker Alt is a colourful slice of anime action that leaves a little to be desired
notes.notes:
Last year, Game Freak took one of its semi-regular breaks from its beloved little pocket monsters in order to bless us with a futuristic, sci-fi adventure, side-scrolling 2D platformer in the form of Giga Wrecker Alt. And now it's just released on console.

It's as inventive and eccentric as the likes of Drill Dozer and Tembo in its own way, with you following the colourful endeavours of a cyborg called Reika Rekkeiji as she navigates her way through a futuristic world in which she is left for dead. She is subsequently rescued by Doctor Kozuki, who provides her with cybernetic implants using technology from robotic invaders. And now she's set to become a serious butt-kicker. Very much like Ghost in the Shell. You know, those kind of vibes... Well, that's what it reminded me of anyway.

Giga Wrecker Alt loosely follows the formula of a Metroidvania platformer. It ticks off most of that trusted checklist, having perfectly timed jumps, ever bigger and badder enemies and a skill tree, which you're able to use nanocrystals in order to upgrade skills, increase maximum health, and unlock new abilities. I've typically steered clear of Metroidvania-type games, but I willingly gave this a chance.

notes.title: "Boss-Rush" update commemorating the summer sale!!
notes.notes:
[h1]It now has a new function, “Astra Rush”![/h1]
[list]
With this function, you can play a boss-rush mode, where you can battle against all the bosses in a row!
If you go leftward from “Region 00”, the first area of “Vimukti, Fortress of the Flying Nymphs”, there will be a door. Going through the door, you will find a machine. Check it and you can play the boss-rush mode.
You need to finish the main story to play “Astra Rush”. If you haven't finished the main story, you won't find anything in the room.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/2b4f8b33d01d577fde61f02c9dce8ef8e43099f1.png[/img]
You can get a new achievement “Mighty Warrior” by clearing “Astra Rush”!
[/list]
[h1]The balance of the game has been adjusted![/h1]
[list]
[*]The difficulty of the boss battles in the main story has been lowered.
The bosses in “Astra Rush” remain as strong as before!
Enjoy the tough fights against the strong bosses!
[*]The default value of the player's HP has been changed from 5 to 10.
[/list]
[h1]Detected bugs have been fixed as below;[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that there were cases that achievement ”I'm the master key” somehow cannot be obtained.
[*]Fixed a bug that massive amount of achievements can be obtained at the start of custom campaign.
[/list]
[h1]Apology[/h1]
[list]
The function to add playable characters, which we announced earlier, will be available with a future update.
We are sorry for keeping you waiting.
 [/list]
thank you for playing GIGA WRECKER!

notes.title: "GIGA WRECKER", the latest title from Game Freak, is finally released!!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/ed5b1f91f3d4afa66d858561d81520518ec927be.png[/img]
About 『GIGA WRECKER』

『GIGA WRECKER』, which from August 2016 was repeatedly fine tuned with feedback from users through Steam Early Access, is a 2D action game in which Reika, a girl who has the ability to manipulate rubble, explores a world dominated by legions of fiendish robots.
Game Freak, the company behind the "Pokémon" series, did the development, and welcomed Asagiri as the graphic concept designer and Shinji Hosoe of SuperSweep co.,ltd. as the sound producer. Please be sure to enjoy this innovative game play that fuses attractive visuals and BGM, as well as action and puzzles.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/4cc9fc7419c3558a89079e6daab505a11b85fcb9.png[/img]
Soundtrack release!!

The 『GIGA WRECKER Soundtrack』 will also get a simultaneous release!
It is configured to let you experience the game vicariously through the music.
Also included are songs that are not in the main release, including versions that could only be heard during Steam Early Access!



『GIGA WRECKER - Soundtrack Bundle』 is also released simultaneously!!

『GIGA WRECKER - Soundtrack Bundle』, the main release of 『GIGA WRECKER』 and the soundtrack as a set, will also be released at the same time!
You can purchase it here at a sale price commemorating the release!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - GIGA WRECKER
notes.notes:
GIGA WRECKER is Now Available on Steam!

GIGA WRECKER is a 2D action adventure game where you play as Reika, a girl who has the ability to manipulate debris and explore a world invaded by an army of evil robots.

Experience and enjoy unique action, attractive characters and dramatic story.

notes.title: Beta-P1 patch is now available, including achievements!
notes.notes:
There are 27 achievements in total.
If you have already fulfilled conditions for certain achievements in the previous versions,
those will be unlocked at the point you load your save data.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/97aa400a7566b7a66baf90814eae33635cb305fd.png[/img]

[h1]Other updates[/h1]
Game controllers other than the Xbox360 controller can be used now!
We have tested XboxOne Controller, DUALSHOCK®4, HORIPAD3 controllers,
and almost all inputtable keys can be set to use in the game.
(Certain functions such as vibrations are not available.)

[h1]Game adjustments[/h1]
We have made adjustments with certain boss battles.
We have made adjustments with certain area designs.
The adjusted area's save data (such as broken terrain) will be reset.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
We have fixed the sound volume when switching areas.
We have fixed the issue where the HUD is visible in other UI and visual effects.
We have fixed the drawing order of the rubber ball.

[h1]Director's comment[/h1]
The game's development is almost complete!
We are now working on debug and reflecting requests and reports
which we have received from players into the game.
Now achievements are set, so the game should look more like a complete title!
Now we have prospect on the release of the full version, so we should start opening information.
We are planning to release the full version around the beginning of February 2017,
so please wait a little more, and thank you for your continuous support on Early Access!

notes.title: BETA UPDATE！
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/101ab708a21f3582fe22505a5456245fb532c85b.png[/img]

【UPDATED FEATURES】

■ THE STORY REACHES ITS ENDING!!
The game story has been updated with the campaign mode during Early Access, and this time it will finally conclude! What fate and future will await the main characters, Reika Rekkeiji and Amane Azuma?
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/81af9fa09d587d5fb9647fdec2e100d62780f3d5.png[/img]


■BEAT THE FINAL STAGE!
The final stage of the campaign is Vimukti, Fortress of the Flying Nymphs.
Each area is full of traps and dangers of the elite robot army, so make full use of all the skills and abilities you have acquired in the game!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/cc2f24f50561f876a0ef56fc2905f5535b432f5b.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/f1a1973d54635fac923858e472fb1cbb9439ce74.png[/img]

■OTHER UPDATES
・Brush-ups have been made with event graphics.
・Event dialogues can be skipped.
・Difficulty of certain boss battles have been adjusted.
・The game’s loading time has been shortened and optimized.
・Other bugs and issues are fixed.

■DIRECTOR’S COMMENT
Thanks to everyone who has supported us from Early Access, now the whole story is playable in the game! First time when I reached the ending, it sure was a deeply emotional experience.

But there are still things to be done!
In the next update the game will become the final release version.
Other than game brush-ups, we are planning to localize the game for many languages.
We are continuing development, so we can reflect opinions and requests provided from players and improve the game’s quality until the final release, so we hope everyone will be looking forward and enjoy “GIGA WRECKER”!

notes.title: "StoryUpdateP1" patch released!
notes.notes:
Thank you for bug reports and feedbacks!
We have released a patch for the story update.
The following is a list of issues we have fixed or updated.

UPDATE: Map objects which were added in the story update are now available in the Map Editor
UPDATE: Brush-ups have been made with graphics in the Navigation Map
MAP: The issue where players become stuck in certain areas when they use the Beacon
MAP: The issue where players can go outside the area map in "Samsāra, Bloodsteel Arsenal: Construction Zone C-04"
FIX: Adjusted the weight of objects created from elastic fluid
FIX: Error message and controls becoming unresponsive in the "Create New Stage" screen 
FIX: Musics not stopping in certain demo scenes
FIX: Controls becoming unresponsive when objects are moved in certain ways in the Map Editor
FIX: Controls becoming unresponsive when a Stage is deleted in the Map Editor
FIX: Switch related objects and doors not interacting properly
FIX: Steel Panels not repeling Debris Javelins properly
FIX: The skill "Unholy Blade" becoming active continuously, regardless of unlocking it or not
FIX: Changed game behaviors when canceling a test play before publishing a custom map
FIX: Effects of boss's shield parts not changing, regardless of their defense status
FIX: Controls becoming unresponsive in the Pause Menu
FIX: Changed behaviors of save data in the Custom Campaign mode
FIX: The World Map cannot be opened in the Map Editor now
FIX: Background graphics will be displayed instantly after creating a new stage

The game flow has changed extensively, so save data cannot be transfered from versions before the story update.
Map related updates will be applied when resetting a stage. (When activating Singularity Points etc.)

※Save data from the story update will be transferred as usual after applying these patches.

notes.title: MAJOR STORY UPDATE！
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/198499a3cda8481ef40af74e2cebdbe051a43ea3.png[/img]

【UPDATED FEATURES】

■ MAJOR STORY UPDATE TOWARDS THE FULL VERSION
So far the story and stage flow are designed for Early Access, but from this update these will be changed towards the full version. A new character “Amane Azuma” will join the game with the player character Reika Rekkeiji. How will they face their destiny in this new story?
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/ad254d3a7beef22ff5cd704b192463a0d74ad62d.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/ce2c49e73a1fc7d2136425b1a25d0adb8b78a2e4.png[/img]
	 
■EXPLORE THE VAST WORLD 
We have redesigned the stages so players can enjoy the “Exploration” part of the game more than before. The newly added World Map will also assist the player through the game.


■MORE ACTION RELATED PUZZLES
There are more action mixed with physics in the new stages. Players can enjoy the achievement of solving puzzles, clearing traps and fighting enemies much more.

■ENEMIES ARE NOT JUST “OBSTACLES”
Now the enemies can be crushed using terrain, so you can fight enemies and solve puzzles at the same time, or even use them to solve puzzles! These changes have added variation to the gameplay.
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/0d0e890cedc4e8636b4c1e22d8798d5e2e9a940d.png[/img]


■UPDATED GRAPHICS
We have made major brush-ups to terrain and background graphics for all stages!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/e15bcc443ee2504d7163594fc7c66908fac3bcbc.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/f62f095a2093c1143ef2c5f788bf6ced3ed99de5.png[/img]

notes.title: 【Game Introduction Part 4:Doctor Kouzuki】
notes.notes:
This time we will introduce Doctor Kouzuki, who supports Reika throughout the game.
He is a scientist with a loose screw, but a nice middle-aged man. (as long as he stays quiet)

Name: Koutarou Kouzuki (上月　コウタロウ)
Birthday: May 23
Age: 46

The very person who turned Reika into a cyborg.
He is a talented human scientist, who was abducted by the robot army and forced to work as a "Brain slave".
They acknowlaged his abilities so saved him from being brainwashed, but he is a complete mad scientist from the beginning.
He is a carefree man, only interested in science and technology. 

Reika has been pushed around by Kouzuki's weird character in the game.
What kind of crazy things will he do or say next?

 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/11313b475e78ff5e535753cb3673e416d0ed0d18.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021643/25e50bbbe5dc43a883ecd224997661b606200dfe.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Introduction Part 1
notes.notes:
Let's start with our main player character!

Name: Reika Rekkeiji (烈景寺　レイカ)
Birthday: February 22th
Age: 19

Her surname Rekkeiji comes from the English word "Wreckage",
and her first name Reika, from "Wrecker" which is also used in the game title GIGA WRECKER.

Personality:
・Active and up-front
・Likes cute things, especially small animals
・Hates the word "Unfair"

As you can see from the dialogs in the game, she is especially enraged by the robot army's unfair and one-sided brutality...

notes.title: Game Freak s Giga Wrecker Now On Early Access
notes.notes:
Game Freak, the studio who brought you little games like Pok mon, have a new game out this week on Early Access. It’s a 2D action puzzle’em up called Giga Wrecker [Steam page], in which you take on the role of an aqua-haired cyborg lady exploring a world invaded by a host of malicious robots.

"After the company's logo, the game becomes unresponsive."

Configured to install the following packages to the game startup:
Visual C++ Redistributable Packages for Visual Studio 2013
Visual C++ Redistributable Packages for Visual Studio 2012
Visual C++ Redistributable Packages for Visual Studio 2010

Sorry for the trouble and inconvenience, and thank you for playing GIGA WRECKER.

notes.title: GIGA WRECKER on Early Access!
notes.notes:
“GIGA WRECKER” is a 2D physics-puzzle action game originally developed and published by GAME FREAK.
The player character is a cyborg girl, who has the power of reconstructing debris and scraps into various weapons, and explores a world invaded by an army of mysterious robots.

This will be our first time to release a title on Early Access.
We would like to increase the quality of our game by receiving feedback, suggestions and absorbing great ideas from users. 
We are excited and looking forward to making GIGA WRECKER together with everyone!
